description:
Search businesses (beauty salons, barbershops, nail and brow studios, massage, spa, clinics and other
appointment-based places) in the uPlanny catalogue. Filter by text, category, place («рядом», «около»,
«недалеко», «возле метро» → `near` or lat/lng with radiusKm), city, salon rating and price; paginated.
Each item has the salon `slug` (for get_salon), rating {average, reviews} or null when there are no
reviews yet, priceFrom (cheapest service, RUB), distanceKm when a place was given, and bookingUrl.

city.description: Only businesses whose address contains this text, e.g. a city «Казань». Ignored when a place is given.

lat.description: Latitude of the place to search around (instead of `near`).

lng.description: Longitude of the place to search around (instead of `near`).

maxPrice.description: Has a service costing at most this, RUB.

minPrice.description: Has a service costing at least this, RUB.

minRating.description: Salon rating at least this (1–5). Salons without reviews are excluded when any rating bound is set.

minReviews.description: With a rating bound: at least this many reviews (default 1).

near.description: A place to search around: address, metro station or landmark, with the city — «Москва, метро Сокол», «Казань, Баумана 10». Used for «рядом», «около», «недалеко», «поблизости».

query.description: Free text: salon name, service, master's name. Russian works best, e.g. «маникюр», «стрижка мужская».

radiusKm.description: Search radius around the place, km (default 3, max 50; ~1 for «в шаговой доступности»).

sort.description: Order. Default: distance when a place is given, otherwise rating.

name: search_salons
title: Поиск салонов
